description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance metric Recall@10 for four different methods or configurations, with the horizontal axis listing the categories: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, scaled linearly from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar labeled "Ours" is colored orange and has a height corresponding to approximately 0.35 on the vertical axis. The bar labeled "- critiquing" is colored blue and reaches approximately 0.3. The bar labeled "- scoring" is also blue and is the shortest, reaching approximately 0.15. The bar labeled "- ranking" is blue and reaches approximately 0.23. The bars are arranged in the order listed on the horizontal axis, from left to right, and are not sorted by height. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any of the bars.
